name: Controls & Direction Notation
summary: Learn EFZ's four buttons and the direction shorthand used in guides.

pages.title: Number-Pad Notation
pages.text: Fighting-game guides and combo lists often use number-pad notation. Imagine the numbers laid over the directions: {dir:6} is toward the opponent, {dir:4} is away, {dir:2} is down, {dir:8} is up, and {dir:5} is neutral. The corner numbers are diagonals: {dir:3} is down-toward, {dir:1} is down-away, {dir:9} is up-toward, and {dir:7} is up-away.

pages.title: Directions Follow Facing
pages.text: Directions follow the way your character faces. After you cross sides, {dir:6} still means toward the opponent and {dir:4} still means away.

pages.title: The Four Buttons
pages.text: EFZ uses {btn:A} A (Light), {btn:B} B (Medium), {btn:C} C (Strong), and {btn:S} S (Special). S has a different use depending on the character; most of the characters don't use it at all.

tasks.label: Press {btn:S}
tasks.prompt: Tap {btn:S}. Nayuki has no universal S move, so don't expect anything flashy - just show us the button press.
